sections.heading: Learning to drive: first part — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: learning to drive: first part within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Starting moving and stopping; Steering and backing; Intersections and turns; Red-light turns and intersection gaps; Roundabouts and lane travel. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Starting, normal stopping, emergency-vehicle response, steering, backing, turns, roundabouts and lane-position exceptions are represented. Arm-signal figures have no extracted posture description and remain a visual gap. The lane-change heading continues on the next mapped section. The left-turn-at-green wording and roundabout exit pattern are retained as source-qualified statements, not expanded into universal permissions.
